headline: Tech-led rally pushes market higher amid geopolitical uncertainty
deck: Nasdaq outperforms as energy concerns ease, but Middle East tensions and asset seizures keep investors cautious.
body:
Markets opened with broad gains today, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq leading the charge at +1.73% while the S&P 500 and Dow followed with more modest gains of +1.13% and +0.61% respectively. The 10-year Treasury held steady at 5.01%, suggesting investors remain somewhat balanced between growth and safety bets despite ongoing international tensions.

Geopolitical headlines continue to dominate sentiment, though recent market moves suggest some stabilization in energy markets. While Iran tensions briefly rattled jet financiers and pushed fuel costs higher, actual shipping data shows Hormuz traffic below recent averages and China's fuel exports hitting record highs—signals that energy supply concerns may be easing. This relief appears to be supporting equities, particularly in the more rate-sensitive tech sector.

The positive tone is tempered by longer-term risks including Putin's targeting of Nestle's Russian operations and Trump facing skeptical world leaders at the UN. These headlines underscore that while markets are finding footing today, underlying geopolitical and corporate exposure issues remain live stories worth monitoring.
